DRSC GlobalCore Senior Analyst, Research & Insights (Cross-Industry)
Kuala Lumpur, MY
The team
Global Strategic Insights Center (GSIC) provides secondary research and analysis services to global Deloitte member firms supporting pursuit, business development, practice development, and client engagements. The team uses exclusive sources, specialized research skills, and industry expertise to develop insightful research reports, delivering significant value to customers across Deloitte’s global network.
Your key responsibilities
Design and deliver decision-ready research and insights across topics including growth strategies, competition, innovation, industry disruptions – using secondary research tools, techniques, and databases.
Author actionable insights and recommendations using strong business writing, storyboarding and visualization skills, with an acute focus on “so-what” for Deloitte's clients and businesses.
Scope research requests — comprehend stakeholders’ insights requirements, assess feasibility, estimate timelines, and present bespoke research solutions to internal stakeholders across Deloitte's global network.
Lead project delivery end-to-end: develop research plans, manage timelines, maintain quality standards, consolidate and review findings from junior team members.
Review and provide feedback on team outputs against Deloitte's brand and quality benchmarks, taking ownership of final deliverable quality.
Engage directly with Deloitte practitioners and leadership across global offices to drive consultative conversations and manage expectations and priorities.
Mentor and train junior analysts and contribute to team initiatives.
Core Skills Required:
Secondary Research Expertise: Possess extensive knowledge of secondary research databases, public/industry-specific sources, and research methodologies to efficiently source and validate relevant information.
Financial Analysis: Experience reading financial statements, interpreting key ratios, and contextualizing company/industry performance data.
Compelling Presentation: Ability to translate complex research findings into visually compelling, executive-ready presentations by content as a logical narrative, supported by well-designed charts, infographics, and data visualizations.
Industry Knowledge: expertise in at least one industry with an understanding of its key performance indicators (KPIs), macroeconomic factors, industry dynamics, operating structures, business models, value chains, regulations, and key trends.
Strong Business Writing Skills:
Ability to communicate complex research ideas compellingly and succinctly through exceptional business writing and storyboarding.
Exceptional Verbal Communication: Ability to articulate ideas confidently in client calls with senior Deloitte leadership and stakeholders.
Qualifications required:
Bachelor’s or master’s degree from a recognized university.
Minimum 5 years of experience in business research in client service or internal setup.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Solid research skills and familiarity with various research databases (Refinitiv, Capital IQ, Factiva, etc.).
Experience working in a global or multi-geography stakeholder environment is an added advantage.
Exposure to Gen AI tools and hands-on experience working on prompt engineering is an advantage.
#DRSCGLOBAL

The Economic Advisory team is looking for candidates with (or currently studying for) a Master’s Degree (or higher) to join our team of economists, based in London, Cambridge, and Manchester in September 2027.
Our work varies across both:
Working across issues in policy, regulation, and subsidy control; business cases; economic appraisal and evaluation; energy market assessment and modelling; macroeconomics and supply chain, and
Working in a variety of sectors including Energy & Utilities; Defence, Security & Justice; Transport; Real Estate & Regeneration; Central Government; Healthcare & Life Sciences.
We value the investment you’ve made in developing your economic skills through your Master’s or PhD studies in economics.
At Deloitte, you will apply microeconomic and macroeconomic theory alongside economic and econometric modelling to address business, consumer and regulatory issues facing our clients. You might tackle questions familiar from your studies—such as how firms and consumers respond to incentives, how markets should be regulated, how policy choices affect different groups in society or how investment affects growth—but apply them to live client challenges. This could involve shaping policy and regulatory frameworks in the energy and transport sectors, developing and appraising investment strategies, building macroeconomic models and forecasts for governments,
assessing the economic and social impacts of major infrastructure projects or considering value-for-money from public sector investments.
Depending on the client question, you may draw on qualitative and quantitative evidence, engage with a wide range of stakeholders and apply approaches such as policy appraisal, behavioural economics and consumer choice, econometrics, financial analysis, and economic and general equilibrium modelling. You will have the opportunity to present your work both in written reports and in presentations and workshops with senior business and policy leaders. Our work is made better through collaboration, and in Economic Advisory you will work alongside a team of fellow economists as well as sector and technical experts from across the firm, both in the UK and globally.
Companies, regulators and governments look to us to help them understand economic issues impacting their business and policies. Your technical expertise and the skills you build in Economic Advisory will ensure you are seen as a trusted advisor in helping them make crucial decisions and making an impact that matters.

Develop solutions to a wide range of high profile and complex problems facing businesses, regulators and governments using a range of software and analytical tools such as econometrics, financial analysis, and economic general/partial equilibrium modelling.
Collaborate with others through debate and discussion, whilst learning how to effectively communicate with others.
Develop strong relationships with clients across a wide range of sectors and countries.
Build long-lasting relationships with colleagues based on mutual respect and trust.
Communicate effectively with clients through presentations, reports and meetings.
Develop report writing, team working, project management skills and the commercial application of economic theory.
Continue with your professional development throughout your career through training opportunities across both soft and technical skills.
Work in multi-disciplinary teams across Deloitte on major projects for both public and private sector clients.
Experience different cultures and local business practices, whilst working with colleagues and clients around the world, as well as enjoying opportunities for national and international travel and secondments as part of a diverse team with an inclusive culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Digital Transformation:

We help clients achieve maximum value on their deal transactions by solving transformational and operational challenges. Carve out and divestment support

M&A Integration
– i.e. How can our clients protect and grow value in an acquisition, what is the right level of integration to achieve this and what does an effectively-run integration programme look like? Operational due diligence

Post-acquisition performance improvement using our Rapid Value Creation methodology

Those in deal integration and valuation realisation at PwC will focus on assisting clients in successfully integrating acquisitions and maximising the value of their investments. You will be responsible for conducting valuations, financial analysis, and developing strategies for post-merger integration.
The Opportunity
As a Deal and Value Creation Analytics member, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Supporting high profile analytics projects showcasing the drivers and equity story of a business either to management or to bidders to increase deal confidence
Supporting analytics projects to arm management with data driven insights to enable fact-based decision making and drive value within the business
Bringing structure and clarity to complex problems and business scenarios within tight deadlines
Using your technical know-how and translating this for our non-technical stakeholders to support robust, evidence-based decisions
Reviewing & creating reports and presentations and translating our findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Working with our Global Data Analytics community to further enhance our analytics proposition

Proven capability to self-motivate and learn
The ability and willingness to travel around up to 20% within Canada and internationally

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance.
As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.
The Opportunity:
As a Digital Operations, Senior Associate, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. You will work closely with Managers and senior team members to translate planning and readiness questions into analytical outputs that inform decision‑making. The role emphasizes strong analytical execution, clear communication of results, and an interest in how analytics is used in real operational decisions. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:
Analytical Problem Solving
Support structuring of operational, logistics, and planning challenges as analytical problems under uncertainty.
Contribute to analysis of trade‑offs involving capacity, inventory, risk, service levels, and timing.
Apply quantitative techniques with appropriate rigor based on guidance from senior team members.
Applied Modelling & Analysis
Build and support quantitative analyses including Supply chain network and flow analysis, Inventory planning under uncertainty, Capacity, throughput, and bottleneck analysis, Scenario and probabilistic analysis using simulation
Support model testing, sensitivity analysis, and validation to ensure outputs are reliable and decision‑relevant.
Technology & Tools
Develop and maintain analytics code, models, and supporting documentation.
Work with data from multiple systems and sources.
Support documentation of business rules, data requirements, process flows, and reporting logic.
Tools may include Python, R, and SQL; optimization solvers; simulation libraries; and enterprise or cloud data platforms.
Follow governed, auditable analytics and documentation practices.
Team & Stakeholder Support
Work collaboratively within project teams to deliver high‑quality analytical outputs.
Support preparation of materials and insights for client discussions.
Proactively flag data, modelling, or assumption risks to senior team members.
Work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
What You'll Bring:
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:
Degree in operations, industrial/systems engineering, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field.
A minimum of 5 years of experience in a relevant field.
Experience applying quantitative or analytical techniques to operations, supply chain, or planning problems in defense, manufacturing, or other asset‑intensive industries.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to data quality and assumptions.
Familiarity with enterprise platforms, system integration concepts, data architecture, and digital workflow enablement is an asset.

Job Description & Summary
We are a multilingual and multidisciplinary team, bringing together people with backgrounds ranging from humanities to finance, operations, technology and data. We have gained experience across different industries, but we share one goal:
helping clients around the world design practical business solutions and build more effective Global Business Services organizations.
Our projects cover the full Global Business Services journey, including operating model design, location analysis, organizational transformation, process optimization, center setup and the improvement of existing operations.
How we work:
We thrive in dynamic environments. Our projects often evolve quickly, requiring frequent adjustments and short decision cycles. You’ll be comfortable working with incomplete information and turning ambiguity into action.
We are agile and iterative. We experiment, pilot, and iterate solutions with our clients, focusing on quick wins that pave the way for sustainable change.
We are cross-functional by design. If your background is in HR, you might lead a Finance or Procurement workstream next. We match people to problems, not to silos - there are no fixed rules.
We are solution-focused and optimistic. We bring energy, creativity and a can-do attitude to every challenge. When the path isn’t obvious, we figure out the next best step and move forward.
We co-create with our clients. We facilitate workshops, rapidly synthesize insights, and turn them into Target Operating Models, process designs and transformation roadmaps.
We learn continuously across functions and technologies. Whether in Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain or Technology, we stay current on domain best practices, regulations and enabling platforms.

Diegem, BE, 1831
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area within EY, and this with a huge potential for you. Manufacturers have long pursued manufacturing excellence programs to continually improve the performance of their facilities and equipment. Many of those initiatives were successful for a time, but they’ve lacked staying power. Today, most manufacturers still struggle to achieve — and sustain — higher levels of performance. And now they also have to deal with escalating digital disruption that increasingly challenges their competitiveness and ability to grow.
Our EY teams understand how to improve productivity for smarter, faster and more advanced manufacturing. With our EY Smart Factory methodology and our unique partnership with P&G at the foundation, we help our clients achieve operational efficiency across the organization to build a better tomorrow!
EY has been rated one of the leading manufacturing consulting firms in the world, and very few organizations match the scope, scale, and ability to lead companies through a sustainable manufacturing transformation. For our growing Supply Chain and Operations practice in Belgium we are looking for a Senior Consultant – Manufacturing to strengthen our manufacturing team.

As a Senior Consultant you support and (co-)lead project delivery teams improving our client’s business performance, in line with our Exceptional Client Service approach, while helping grow our practice outside of your client work. Drawing on your knowledge, skills and experience, you will start to build valued relationships with external clients and internal peers, support bids, proposals and thought leadership.
You will work independently as well as in teams. You will coach and support consultants and client team members, perform analyses and report finding and results. You will share your expertise with other colleagues in the manufacturing excellence team of EY Belgium, residing in the broader Supply Chain & Operations team.

Entrepreneurial spirit, excellent communication skills & passion for winning;

Strategy & Value Creation is EY’s executive strategy practice. The EY-Parthenon brand is the home of our fast-growing global strategy capability. We advise corporate and private equity clients on strategic and on strategic, commercial, operational, and investment-related decisions that drive long-term value creation. Areas of our work include:
Corporate and BU strategy
Strategy assessment
Market entry strategy and opportunity sizing
Product and business unit strategy development
Divestment options analysis
Purpose-led strategy and long-term value
Business model reinvention
Portfolio strategy
Digital & AI strategy and innovation
Go-to-market strategy
Strategic cost evaluation
Commercial due diligence
Turnaround, operational restructuring and rapid performance improvement
Working capital advisory
Capital allocation and investment strategy
You'll work with a high-performing, integrated team which focuses on a variety of global and local corporate, government, and private equity clients. You'll have a diverse range of stretching experiences which will give you continuous learning and development opportunities as well as a great sense of achievement. The Canadian Practice is closely integrated with the Americas EY Parthenon organization. We bring the power of our deep global and local insights, client relationships and an informed, current perspective.
This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

We are looking for candidates to join as a Consultant in the Canadian Strategy & Value Creation team. Consultants will play an integral role that involves working closely with other members of the rapidly growing Americas Strategy & Value Creation team to deliver a variety of engagements.
We are looking for candidates who can:
Independently perform primary and secondary research including data gathering, interviews, and surveys
Develop and execute workplans including analytics, both qualitative and quantitative
Develop the ‘story’ – the output to narrate the solution to the client’s problem – including written output (slides)
Develop and sustain effective relationships with client stakeholders
Foster an inclusive culture throughout the team and within engagements
Develop a community within the team – volunteering to support business development activities or other internal practice build initiatives such as Learning, Operations, Resourcing, Recruitment, etc.
Proactively build a personal network within the firm
Be comfortable in a team environment that actively encourages members voicing different views to reach the optimal solution for clients
Be entrepreneurial in seeking ways to deliver increased client impact
Ideal qualifications for this position include:
Engineering, Finance or Commerce undergrad (MA/MBA is an asset)
At least 2 years of work/leadership experience with demonstrated impact with management consulting or corporate strategy experience preferred
Exceptional problem-solving skills – analytical, quantitative and conceptual
Finance and operational knowledge – strong understanding of profitability and cash-flow metrics, including the ability to explain how operational improvements affect financial statements
Advanced modelling skills (Excel) and visualization skills (PowerPoint, Tableau and/or Power BI)
Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under demanding environment, overtime and adhere to project deadlines
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated track record of communicating complex ideas and findings to senior executives
A passion for delivering impact, demonstrated initiative taking, high energy and curiosity, and the ability to adapt to new challenges and ideas
Comfort with ambiguity

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them - often in politically charged environments. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

The opportunity
EY’s Technology Strategy & Transformation team helps public sector clients navigate complex digital transformations. We are seeking a Senior Consultant based in Ottawa to support engagements focused on federal government modernization initiatives. This role requires strong consulting experience, deep understanding of government technology strategy, and proven stakeholder management skills. Security clearance is required.
We are looking for candidates with experience in one or more of the following Technology Transformation capabilities:
IT-enabled Business Transformation and Value Creation
: Help clients design the transformation of their business by leveraging technology-enabled solutions. Help clients uncover opportunities to create incremental business value by transforming digital experiences, business processes and associated enabling technology.
Technology Strategy and IT Operating Model:
Help our clients align their technology and digital strategy to their business strategic direction. Deliver technology strategy engagements, including digital operating model design, modernization roadmaps, and transformation planning. Stay current on federal government priorities, digital trends, and emerging technologies relevant to public sector transformation. Capabilities within this include current-state assessments, technology and digital roadmap development, next-generation IT operating model design, sourcing structure, organization design, organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, governance structure, performance, risk management, and sourcing.
Program Delivery:
Help client stakeholders on their most complex portfolio and program challenges and provide advice on program delivery activities such as program setup and rapid mobilization, scope and cost management, schedule and resource management, project management activities around design, implementation and sustainment, quality management, change management, and outcome and benefits management.

Drives structured and creative problem solving using AI
– Uses AI to accelerate analysis, scenario generation, and insight development while maintaining clear linkage to business outcomes
Builds repeatable ways of working with AI
– Develops and shares prompts, approaches, and tool usage that improve team productivity and consistency in existing data libraries/catalogues

L’équipe Transformation CIB Corporate & Investment Banking d’EY France évolue au cœur des métiers de conseil en Services Financiers dans un contexte de forte croissance de nos activités.
Nous intervenons sur un large spectre de missions visant à permettre à nos clients d’être plus performants, plus sûrs, plus justes et plus durables dans le respect des contraintes de leur marché et en ligne avec leurs fortes ambitions. Nos clients sont des banques de financement et d’investissement, des fonds d’investissement, des institutions de marchés, des structures de marchés (échanges, chambres de compensation, dépositaires), des teneurs de comptes & conservateurs, des services de banque d’entreprise...
Vos principales responsabilités
Choisir notre équipe, c’est savoir qu’aucun mois ne ressemblera à un autre - par exemple :
Janvier
:
Cadrage et mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques des clients du secteur de la banque d’investissement et de la banque de marché ; Définition et mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels cibles, Conduite et pilotage des projets de transformation métiers et fonctions supports ; adaptation de contraintes risques et réglementaires sur des activités de marché
Février :
Accompagnement d’une banque d’investissement dans le lancement de nouvelles initiatives de financements structurés et transformation de ses pratiques front to back ; revue des processus de la banque à des fins d’optimisation
Mars
: Définition d’un plan d’efficacité opérationnelle, d’amélioration de la performance, de revue de la proposition de valeur et de réduction des coûts
Avril :
Accompagnement de deux sociétés de financement dans leur projet de consolidation (PMI) ou encore définition des cas d’usage autour de l’intelligence artificielle pour une banque d’investissement
Mai :
Accompagnement à la structuration d’un fonds ESG et Replatforming IT / Digital.
En fonction de votre grade, vous participerez ou piloterez des missions telles que :
Accompagnement de projets de transformation front-to-back (processus, outils, gouvernance)
Revue et optimisation des dispositifs de conformité réglementaire (MiFID II, EMIR, SFTR, DORA…)
Support à la mise en œuvre d’outils de trading, de clearing ou de post-trade
Diagnostic organisationnel et amélioration de l'efficacité opérationnelle
Cadrage et pilotage de projets stratégiques dans les activités de marchés (équities, fixed income, dérivés, clearing, etc.)
Management d’équipe et encadrement de consultants (pour les managers)
Contribution à la veille réglementaire et à la capitalisation interne
Aussi, en parallèle de vos projets auprès des clients, vous participerez également à de nombreux travaux internes.

Promis, pas de liste à rallonge, mais des compétences clés pour vous permettre de réussir avec nous :
Selon votre niveau d’expérience, vous avez une connaissance des marchés financiers, des instruments financiers, des produits structurés, des stratégies de financement et d'investissement, et des processus opérationnels Front-to-Back du secteur CIB.
Expérience de 3 à 6 ans (Senior Consultant), 6 à 10 ans (Manager) acquise en cabinet de conseil ou au sein d’un acteur des marchés financiers
Solide compréhension des produits financiers et des chaînes front-to-back
Connaissance des enjeux réglementaires liés aux activités de marché

Vous combinez un esprit d'analyse et de synthèse avec rigueur et méthode, et vous êtes capable de remettre en question les idées reçues.
Vous appréciez le contact avec des clients exigeants et l'intervention sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur : Direction Investissement, Métiers (Front-to-back), Risques, Conformité, Comptabilité, Finance, Data Office, DSI, organes de Transformation & Organisation… cela ne vous intimide pas.
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et en mode projet et vous faites preuve de flexibilité et d'adaptabilité.
Vous êtes curieux et polyvalent : une appétence pour explorer des sujets en constante évolution dans l'univers technologique et réglementaire, dans des contextes clients très variés.
Niveau d’anglais professionnel exigé

Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY
L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.
Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.

Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 entretiens (RH et métier) dont une étude de cas. Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions.

Technical Excellence
Business Planning & Service Delivery
Convert business priorities into clear operating plans, capacity requirements, service objectives and team goals.
Own end-to-end delivery for the assigned finance process or portfolio, ensuring agreed service levels, quality, accuracy and timeliness.
Monitor operational performance through meaningful KPIs, root-cause analysis and action plans; provide transparent updates to leadership and stakeholders.
Plan resources effectively across business cycles, month/quarter/year-end peaks, transitions and transformation initiatives. Finance Process Leadership
Lead one or more finance domains based on experience and business need: RTR, PTP, OTC, Treasury, Controllership and/or FP&A.

For PTP: oversee purchasing-to-payment operations including invoice processing, controls, vendor queries, payments, ageing and working-capital opportunities, as applicable.
For OTC: oversee billing, cash application, collections, credit management, dispute resolution, receivables reporting and working-capital performance, as applicable.

Ensure processes operate in accordance with company policies, accounting standards, delegation of authority, regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks.
Maintain robust process documentation, SOPs, desktop procedures, control evidence and knowledge repositories.
Identify financial and operational risks early, implement preventive and corrective actions, and support internal, statutory and external audits.
Promote a strong controls and compliance culture while balancing governance with efficient business outcomes. Transformation & Operational Excellence
Drive simplification, standardization, automation and productivity improvement across the assigned portfolio.
Use data and process insights to identify recurring issues, remove non-value-added activities and improve customer experience.
Partner with technology, process owners and business teams on system implementations, migrations, transitions and continuous-improvement programs.
Embed scalable ways of working and share leading practices across teams and locations. Stakeholder & Change Management
Build trusted relationships with business finance, operations, procurement, sales, tax, legal, technology, banks, vendors, customers and auditors, as relevant to the portfolio.
Facilitate governance reviews, resolve escalations, communicate trade-offs clearly and ensure ownership of agreed actions.
Act as a change leader during organizational, process and technology transformation. People Leadership
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with clear accountability, role clarity and performance expectations.
Plan staffing, hiring, onboarding, succession and capability development in line with current and future business needs.
Create an inclusive, collaborative and learning-oriented environment that supports engagement, retention and internal mobility.

2-5 years

Business Consulting

Drawing on your knowledge and experience, you will create innovative insights for clients, bringing software / digital solutions and strategies to optimise their asset management capabilities and sustain performance improvement. As an influential member of the team, you will help create a positive learning culture; coach, counsel, and nurture junior team members.

Governance and Assurance
Design Asset Governance frameworks and Target Operating Models aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements
Conduct ISO 55001 alignment assessments and EAM maturity diagnostics
Develop risk, control, and performance assurance frameworks across asset lifecycle processes
Integrate ESG considerations into asset strategies, governance models, and performance reporting
Lifecycle Strategy & TOTEX Optimization
Develop Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs) and asset class level AM plans
Design and document EAM processes, policies, and procedures across the end to end asset lifecycle
Support asset investment planning, prioritization, and portfolio optimization
Define value frameworks and TOTEX optimization approaches linking Capex, Opex, risk, and performance
Support asset decommissioning strategies and transition planning
Asset Performance & Reliability
Deliver asset performance optimization and reliability improvement initiatives
Design and improve maintenance management and reliability engineering frameworks
Support work management transformation, including planning, scheduling, and execution optimization
Optimize asset spares and inventory strategies to balance availability, cost, and risk
Asset Intelligence & Decision Enablement
Define asset data and information management strategies, including data governance and quality
Develop decision support frameworks and AI readiness roadmaps for EAM and asset￼intensive operations
Support selection, assessment, and optimization of EAM systems (e.g., SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle)
Drive IoT and sensorization use cases for condition monitoring and predictive insights
Support implementation of digital twins and BIM enabled asset management solutions

Work closely with MENA clients to translate business and asset management challenges into practical, scalable EAM solutions
Lead and contribute to client workshops, diagnostics, and design sessions
Deliver high‑quality consulting outputs aligned to EY quality and delivery standards
Support business development and proposal efforts aligned to established EAM offerings
Coach junior team members and contribute to capability building within the EAM practice

Strong EAM domain knowledge across governance, lifecycle management, maintenance, and performance
Experience working across asset intensive industries (Oil & Gas, Utilities, Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Cities and Municipalities, Facility Management, etc.)
Understanding of ISO 55001, ESG, and risk based asset management concepts
Exposure to AI, analytics, IoT, digital twins, and emerging asset technologies
Structured problem solving, client facing communication, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to translate strategy into operable processes, frameworks, and systems

4–8 years of experience in Enterprise Asset Management, Asset intensive Operations, or related consulting roles
Consulting experience in asset performance improvement, governance, cost optimization, or process design
Exposure to EAM systems (SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle, Asset investment planning tool, etc.)
Experience developing process documentation, frameworks, and maturity assessments
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management
Willingness to travel onsite for client assignments, if required
Willingness to work Sunday to Thursday and support MENA region’s client timings
Ideally, you should also have
Project management skills
Customer handling, Report writing, Strong interpersonal communication skills, and experience in usage of analytical tools/ representations
Certification / working knowledge in ISO 55001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001
Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, KAIZEN, CAMA 2, IAM Diploma and IAM certificate as an added/preferred advantage

A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of business consultant professionals, in the integrated global business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY Business Consulting practices regionally/globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

CONSULTANT – Industria 4.0 & Business Incentives (Milano)

Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:
Investimento sulle competenze del futuro

In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo.

attività legate a

Laurea magistrale in materie tecnico-scientifiche (preferibilmente in Ingegneria) o in Economia
Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative
Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (con particolare riferimento a Excel e Power Point)

: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.

nel tuo benessere personale e
nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.

accedere a
benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati
;
partecipare a
programmi di leadership
.

Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.

Together, all in.

Amsterdam, NL, 1083 HP
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.
Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.
Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Technologie is tegenwoordig een belangrijk onderdeel bij transformaties binnen organisaties en heeft daarbij impact op de structuur van organisaties en de manier van werken. Als Senior Consultant Technology Strategy & Transformation begeleid je organisaties bij veranderingen, variërend van kortlopende strategische trajecten (zoals het ontwerpen van de IT-visie, strategie en operating model) tot langdurige transformatieprogramma’s en (technologie) implementaties die de organisatie en werkwijze fundamenteel veranderen. De diensten die we aanbieden richten zich voornamelijk op de agenda's van de Chief Technology Officer (CTO) en Chief Information Officer (CIO).
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:
Je vervult een leidende rol, waarin je onder meer verantwoordelijk bent voor de volgende werkzaamheden:
Ondersteuning van klanten bij de ontwikkeling van technologie, IT-visie, strategie, operating model, organisatie-inrichting, governance en kostenoptimalisatie.
Advisering aan klanten bij het (strategisch) ontwerp en implementatie van de nieuwste technologische innovaties, zoals Gen AI of grote platformen zoals SAP en Microsoft.
Ontwerpen en implementeren van (IT) oplossingen die zijn afgestemd op de bedrijfsdoelen, strategische context en operationele modellen van de klant.
Voorbereiden van C-level besluitvormingsmaterialen, ondersteund door gedegen analyses en heldere storytelling.
Verantwoordelijk voor delen van een project, van project/programma management, uitvoeren van analyses en het opleveren van adviezen.
Ondersteunen en coachen van junior collega's.
Betrokken zijn bij industrieonderzoek, klantgericht leiderschap, RFP's en/of klant rondetafelgesprekken.
Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met klanten en collega's om nieuwe kansen te identificeren en proactief te communiceren. Hierbij ontwikkel je diepgaande klantrelaties en positioneer je jezelf als een ‘trusted advisor’. Je neemt eigenaarschap over je eigen carrière en ontwikkeling.
Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor
Jouw Team
Je komt terecht in een hecht en ambitieus team van circa 65 collega’s. We werken op vrijdag samen op kantoor en sluiten de week af met een vrijdagmiddag borrel. Daarnaast organiseren we regelmatig team activiteiten en gaan we jaarlijks op skitrip.
Je werkt samen aan impactvolle projecten met strategen, managers en andere ervaren professionals waarbij je ook met andere teams binnen consulting kunt samenwerken. Wij werken binnen het team in een matrixstructuur van chapters en sectoren. In chapters bouw je diepgaande kennis op binnen thema’s zoals AI, CIO Advisory, Cloud en front-to-back transformaties. Vervolgens pas je deze expertise toe binnen specifieke sectoren, zoals Banking, Insurance, Government & Infra, Consumer & Health, Industrial & Energy en Technology, Media & Telecom.
Voorbeelden van enkele projecten:
Ontwikkeling van IT-visie, strategie en operating models in diverse sectoren.
Analyse van enterprise architectuur en roadmap aanbevelingen voor een toekomstbestendige inrichting
Implementatie van softwareoplossingen binnen o.a. verzekeraars, banken en consumer goods.
Selectie van ESG supply chain software voor een internationale organisatie.
Strategie en implementatie roadmap voor de migratie naar Public Cloud voor een internationale bank.
Begeleiding van end-to-end AI Transformaties, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van de Agentic Software delivery lifecycle en bijbehorende aanpassingen in het operating model.
Programmamanagement binnen een IT-afdeling in de publieke sector.
Ontwikkeling van GenAI-strategieën.
Jouw Kantoor
Amsterdam
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze high-tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen.
Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage
Een masterdiploma met een sterke affiniteit voor IT, Digital en Business zoals Business Information (Management), Digital Business, Industrial Engineering of een andere vergelijkbare studie
Minstens 3 jaar relevante werkervaring op het gebied van IT, afkomstig van een IT-consultancyorganisatie, of andere relevante bedrijfsrol.
Je bent in staat om verantwoordelijkheid over delen van projecten te nemen. Waarin je zelfstandig analyses uitvoert en omzet naar adviezen.
Je hebt ervaring in het begeleiden van junior collega’s.
Sterke analytische en kritische denkvaardigheden.
Sterke interpersoonlijke en communicatieve vaardigheden en bereidheid om bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van het team.
Een proactieve en flexibele werkinstelling, met een hoog aanpassingsvermogen waarbij je om kunt gaan met snel veranderende situaties en waarbij het grootste deel van de tijd wordt doorgebracht op klantlocaties.
Bij voorkeur een vorm van certificering op een van de volgende onderwerpen: SAFe, TOGAF en ITIL.
Affiniteit met of ervaring in één of meer van de volgende sectoren is een pre: Banking, Insurance, Government & Infra, Consumer & Health, Industrial & Energy en Technology, Media & Telecom.
Affiniteit met of ervaring in één of meer van de volgende kennisgebieden is een pre: AI, CIO Advisory, Cloud en front-to-back transformaties.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse- en Engelse taal in woord en schrift.
Als je niet aan elke eis voldoet, maar gelooft dat deze rol de juiste volgende stap voor jou is, horen we toch graag van je.
Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier
Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Boven op je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).
Je krijgt een contract voor 40 uur.
Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.
29 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen.
Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.
Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.
De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.
De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.
Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.
Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.
Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.
En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik
hier
Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces
We ontvangen graag je cv en motivatiebrief. In je motivatiebrief lezen we graag over je ervaring binnen ten minste één van de genoemde sectoren of kennisgebieden. Je sollicitatie nemen we alleen in behandeling als je een motivatiebrief meestuurt.
Ons eerste contact en het eerste gesprek: na jouw sollicitatie belt onze recruiter voor een introductiegesprek. Als de rol goed aansluit plannen we een eerste gesprek in met een collega van de afdeling. Dit is een wederzijdse kennismaking. Voor het eerste gesprek vragen we je om een online assessment te maken. Geen standaard vragenlijst, maar een game-based assessment waarin zowel naar jouw cognitieve vaardigheden als je gedragsvoorkeuren wordt gekeken.
Het tweede gesprek: Als wij na het eerste gesprek een match zien en jij ook nog enthousiast bent, volgt er een tweede kennismaking. In dit gesprek gaan we dieper in op de functie en andere relevante thema’s en soms maakt een businesscase ook onderdeel uit van de procedure. Hierna vindt er nog een laatste gesprek plaats met een partner van de afdeling.
We zijn een match. Je ontvangt van ons een aanbod en we doen een pre employment screening. Daarna start jouw nieuwe uitdaging. Welkom bij EY!

EY-Parthenon - Senior Consultant - Transaction Analytics
Sydney, NSW, AU, 2000
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
EY’s Transaction Analytics team continues to grow, and we are looking for high‑performing Senior Consultants to join our growing team!
This role is suited to experienced consultants and senior consultants who understand how transactions work end‑to‑end and are excited by the opportunity to apply data and analytics to real commercial questions across the deal lifecycle. You will work at the intersection of strategy, transactions and analytics, supporting high‑profile buy‑side and sell‑side engagements alongside Corporate Finance and Transaction Diligence teams.
As a Senior Consultant, you will play a hands‑on role in delivering transaction‑focused analytics, helping investors and management teams identify value drivers, understand risks and make informed decisions at critical moments in a deal. This is an opportunity to deepen your deal exposure while building a differentiated skill set that combines commercial thinking with advanced analytics capability.
This is a full-time hybrid position based in our Naarm - Melbourne and Warrang - Sydney office.
Your key responsibilities
Deliver transaction‑focused analytics across buy‑side and sell‑side engagements, including diligence, sell‑side preparation, carve‑outs and post‑deal value creation, applying analytics to real commercial questions across the deal lifecycle.
Analyse large, complex datasets using Alteryx and related tools to identify value drivers, risks, trends and anomalies that matter to investors and management teams in a transaction context.
Translate sophisticated analysis into clear, commercially relevant insights for transaction professionals, private equity clients and corporate stakeholders.
Work as part of integrated deal teams alongside Corporate Finance and Transaction Diligence, supporting Managers and Senior Managers on delivery, proposals and client discussions
Skills and attributes for success
Experience in consulting, strategy, deals or transaction‑related roles, with exposure to the transaction lifecycle and a strong understanding of how analytics supports deal decision‑making.
Strong analytics capability, including hands‑on experience working with large datasets in tools such as Alteryx, with working knowledge of SQL, Python and/or R highly regarded.
A commercial mindset, with the ability to connect data and analysis to strategy, value creation and transaction outcomes rather than purely technical outputs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, multidisciplinary deal environments
Why EY Transaction Analytics?
EY has been recognised by Mergermarket as the#1 deal advisor by value and volume in Australia and New Zealand for seven consecutive years. As part of Transaction Analytics, you will work on some of the region’s most significant transactions while developing a distinctive analytics‑led deal skillset early in your career.
You will gain exposure to complex, high‑impact deals, learn directly from experienced Managers, Senior Managers and Partners, and build a clear pathway toward future leadership roles within Strategy and Transactions.

EY Parthenon – Consultant or Senior Consultant - ROAM Electricity Market Modelling
The opportunity
At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.
Climate change is driving an unprecedented transformation in the global energy sector. The energy industry is transitioning to a low carbon, decentralised future, facing a wide range of engineering and economic challenges along the way. The scale of infrastructure development needed to transform our energy sector is immense with investments and transactions in the energy sector expected to continue to grow over the next decade. Do you want to be part of this journey in our growing team?
EY-ROAM is a leading provider of electricity market modelling services in Australia and New Zealand. Our role in the energy industry is to provide evidence-based insights, enabling our clients to make informed decisions amidst uncertainty and change, cutting through the complexity to provide actionable insights.
We simulate electricity markets and power systems to forecast how they change in different future scenarios. Our market models use a physics first approach where representation of the transmission network is key. Our clients span the energy value chain including renewable energy and storage developers, energy sector investors, transmission and distribution network service providers, retailers, regulators and governments.
This is a hybrid position based in Meanjin – Brisbane or Warrang – Sydney.
Your key responsibilities
We are looking for several Consultants and Senior Consultants in our Brisbane and Sydney teams.
As a member of the team, you will be involved in the execution and delivery of a broad range of exciting market modelling projects and will provide our clients evidence-based insights that enable informed decision making. Some roles will be transaction-focussed.
In parallel with client engagements, you will also have the opportunity to target your learning and development towards key areas of interest.
We are seeking candidates who are passionate about rapidly expanding their understanding of energy markets and using that knowledge in a fast-paced consulting environment.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have the skills and attributes below but don’t worry if you don’t tick all the boxes. We’re interested in your aptitude, attitude and willingness to learn.
Tertiary education in a discipline such as engineering, mathematics, economics, physics, or computer science,
Demonstrated ability to work independently,
High numeracy levels and the ability, or a willingness to develop the ability, to manipulate and analyse large data sets efficiently and with the ability to deal with ambiguities within data,
High computer literacy. Currently, we use Excel, Python, SQL and Microsoft VBA to interface with our custom simulation software. We will provide time and training if you can demonstrate your willingness and ability to learn a new programming language,
The ability to employ best practice in data visualisation for both analysis and presentation
Strong communication skills with the ability to successfully convey meaningful insights to clients and colleagues,
An understanding of, or willingness to learn the fundamentals of electricity markets and the challenges that need to be addressed as decarbonisation occurs, and
Experience in energy transactions will be highly valued, whether it be preparing, supporting or evaluation of bids.

EY-Parthenon (Senior) Consultant Tech - Strategy and Transactions (w/m/d)
Berlin, BE, DE, 10117
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A? Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Execution-Tech-Teams in Düsseldorf, Hamburg, Berlin, Stuttgart, Frankfurt/Main oder München begleitest du unsere Kund:innen bei komplexen Herausforderungen und Transformationen. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
Du berätst nationale und internationale Unternehmen bei IT-strategischen Fragestellungen, insbesondere zur Konzeption von IT Target Operating Modells und ganzheitlichen Transformationsprogrammen.
Du unterstützt bei strukturellen Veränderungssituationen wie Transaktionen (z.B. Carve-Outs, Integrationen), Turnaround-Programmen sowie Restrukturierungskonzepten mit Fokus auf Value Creation.
Du entwickelst und setzt IT-Strategien, Transformationen, Optimierungen und Kostenreduzierungen um.
Du verbindest bei entsprechender Expertise strategische AI-Beratung mit technologischer Umsetzung und entwickelst innovative Lösungen in den Bereichen AI-Architektur, Advanced Analytics, Data Engineering oder intelligenter Automatisierung.
Dein Skillset
Du hast ein überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Engineering oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs, idealerweise mit großem Interesse an IT-Strategie- und Transaktionsberatung.
Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen in der (IT) Strategie- oder Transaktionsberatung (Consultant) oder mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung (Senior Consultant) im Bereich IT-Projektmanagement mit, idealerweise mit einem Schwerpunkt in IT-Strategie, Transformation oder AI, sowie einem sehr guten Verständnis für Corporate-IT-Umgebungen.

Agil
: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.

: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
Teamorientiert
: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert.

Dublin 2, IE

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
EY Parthenon Strategy - Consultant
General Information
Location:
Ireland / Dublin / Cork / Limerick / Galway
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship:
YES
Business Area:
EYP
Contract Type:
Full-Time – Permanent
About EY-Parthenon Strategy
EY-Parthenon Strategy is EY’s global strategy consultancy, with more than 9,700 professionals working across three areas of focus: corporate and business unit strategy, growth strategy, and commercial due diligence. In 2024, EY-Parthenon was ranked 6th in Vault’s Top 50 Consulting Firms to Work For.
At EY-Parthenon Strategy, we put our purpose — building a better working world — at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to using unconventional yet pragmatic thinking to deliver actionable strategies in order to help our clients navigate the ever-changing business landscape.
You will be a part of a collaborative team that applies the latest thinking, research, and analytics to help transform clients’ businesses and solve complex problems. Working at EY-Parthenon Strategy offers the opportunity to change how world-leading organisations do business.
We advise on a vast range of issues, such as core value propositions, competitive positioning, and growth strategies. EY-Parthenon Strategy employees enjoy unparalleled contact with influential and highly experienced professionals at clients organisations, across a multitude of sectors.
The below relates to applications for the EY-Parthenon Strategy Ireland team only. If you are looking to apply for Transaction Strategy & Execution or Turnaround & Restructuring Strategy, please visit the EY Careers pages to apply.
The opportunity
We are currently seeking applications at the Consultant level. This is a unique opportunity to work with a diverse set of clients to solve their most difficult and important challenges. In EY-Parthenon Strategy, we work alongside our clients to help them prepare for the future. EY-Parthenon has a flat structure which will allow you to become actively involved in many levels of client work.
The team adopts a methodical and collaborative approach with clients to jointly answer the key strategic questions they are faced with. Examples of the work you will be involved in include
Working with senior leaders at clients to help them develop their organisational strategy – including defining the organisation’s purpose, outlining its strategic objectives, identifying key customer segments, planning to enter new geographies, building new go-to-market approaches, mapping the capabilities required for success, and tracking performance.
Delivering commercial due diligence to support M&A transactions, on both the buy-side and the sell-side.
Conducting business development activities to win projects with potential clients.
Developing a community within the team by building initiatives, writing thought leadership, getting involved in recruitment, and supporting internal team activities.
Skills and attributes for success
Successful candidates are intellectually curious, passionate about solving complex problems, hardworking, driven, have an enthusiastic and approachable demeanour, and have an entrepreneurial mindset. We want people who are creative, great communicators, who collaborate well with others, and who have a desire to learn.
Some of the traits we are looking for
Ability to confidently handle ambiguity and break complex problems into their constituent parts.
Ability to adopt and effectively communicate a logical, structured thought process.
Demonstrable quantitative and qualitative analysis skills.
Excellent written communication skills.
Strong verbal communications skills, including experience presenting to senior audiences.
Ability to quickly build trusting relationships with people.
Enjoys working in a highly collaborative and fast-paced team environment.
A passion for learning and sharing knowledge.
Strong business acumen.
Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
Effective time management skills with an ability to work under pressure with tight deadlines.
An entrepreneurial mindset to help build our fast-growing team.
What working at EY offers
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:
Pension
Discounted health insurance
Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP
consultations for you and your family
The purchase of additional annual leave
Hybrid Working
Free Gym membership
Travel Pass
Maternity & Paternity leave
Bike to work Scheme
Recognition Awards
Cash incentives for referrals
Work Mobile
Tech MBA paid by EY
Wellness rooms available in some offices
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
Career Progression
When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees.
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
Inclusion & Diversity
We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients.
We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and building a culture where we support all our people to achieve their potential. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
IMPORTANT: Where Agency assistance is required, our Talent Team will engage directly with suppliers. CVs / Profiles should not be shared directly with Hiring Managers. Unsolicited CVs / Profiles supplied to EY by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: EY Parthenon - Consultant Strategy And Execution

EY, leader mondiale nei servizi professionali di advisory, ricerca un/una
da inserire nel proprio team italiano di Strategy & Execution.
jd_text:
EY Parthenon - Consultant Strategy And Execution
Milano, MI, IT, 20144
L’opportunità
EY, leader mondiale nei servizi professionali di advisory, ricerca un/una
Senior Consultant
da inserire nel proprio team italiano di Strategy & Execution.
Il team fornisce servizi di financial advisory e consulenza strategica ad aziende, istituzioni finanziarie ed investitori principalmente nel
segmento degli illiquid assets
(credito, special situations, real estate e turnaround & restructuring).
Il nostro team
Lavoriamo a fianco di:
fondi di investimento (private equity, private debt, credito distressed),
credit servicer e piattaforme specializzate,
banche e istituzioni finanziarie,
gruppi industriali e imprenditori,
su
operazioni straordinarie
,
piani industriali e di trasformazione
,
operazioni di ristrutturazione e rilancio
, anche in contesti complessi o di crisi.
Il tuo ruolo
Nel ruolo di Consultant ti occuperai di:
Eseguire analisi numeriche e predisporre modelli finanziari (es. modelli di valutazione, business plan, forecast)
Partecipare ad attività di due diligence finanziaria e strategica/commerciale
Svolgere ricerche di mercato e di settore, incluse analisi di benchmarking
Contribuire alla redazione di report, presentazioni e documenti di progetto destinati ai clienti o agli stakeholder interni
Supportare nella preparazione di presentazioni per meeting e comitati (pitch, investment memo, report di avanzamento)
Sviluppare soluzioni basate su dati e insight, contribuendo a roadmap strategiche e decisioni critiche
Gestire le relazioni con il cliente a livello operativo, garantendo elevati standard qualitativi
Il profilo ideale
Il/La candidato/a ideale possiede i seguenti requisiti:
Esperienza lavorativa di
2-4 anni
maturata presso Big 4, boutique di advisory, società di consulenza, fondi di investimento, banche o credit servicer;
Esperienza in
corporate finance, transaction advisory, due diligence e valutazione finanziaria
; precedenti esperienze su asset illiquidi e/o special situations/restructuring sono considerate un plus;
Laurea in discipline economiche o ingegneristiche;
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata);
Solida padronanza del pacchetto Office (in particolare
Excel e PowerPoint
);
Approccio analitico, flessibile e orientato alla risoluzione di problemi complessi;
Ottime capacità relazionali e di lavoro in team;
Disponibilità a viaggiare in Italia e all’estero.
Che cosa stiamo cercando
Cerchiamo
professionisti curiosi, motivati e ad alto potenziale
, interessati a costruirsi competenze distintive, a crescere in un contesto dinamico e lavorare su
progetti rilevanti ed innovativi
.
Cerchiamo persone con una visione aperta e internazionale, che vogliano contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo del team e incarnare i valori di EY.
Che cosa vogliamo offrirti
Entrando in EY avrai l’opportunità di:
Lavorare su
progetti ad elevato contenuto strategico
e su asset class complesse e in evoluzione;
Sviluppare una
professionalità distintiva
grazie al sistema EY Badges e a percorsi di crescita strutturati;
Investire sullo sviluppo della tua
leadership a 360°
, non solo tecnica;
Ricevere coaching continuo da professionisti riconosciuti come esperti nel loro settore;
Costruire rapidamente un
network professionale di alto profilo
, interfacciandoti con il top management di importanti gruppi italiani e internazionali;
Beneficiare di
modalità di lavoro flessibili
e di un ambiente moderno e inclusivo;
Lavorare in un contesto che valorizza
Diversity & Inclusion

SI:
Svetovalec začetnik - EY Parthenon: Strateško svetovanje
Lokacija: Ljubljana, Slovenija
V EY smo predani oblikovanju vaše prihodnosti s samozavestjo.
Pomagali vam bomo uspeti v globalno povezanem središču raznolikih ekip in vas popeljati na vašo karierno pot, kamor želite.
Pridružite se EY in pomagajte graditi boljši delovni svet.
Priložnost
Razvijamo strategije, ki premikajo poslovanje naših naročnikov naprej. Povezujemo poglobljene analize z idejami, ki imajo resničen vpliv na to, kako delujejo podjetja okoli nas. Dali vam bomo priložnost, da spoznate širok nabor industrij in sodelujete pri projektih, ki podjetjem prinašajo pozitivne spremembe.
Vaša vloga v ekipi
Predstavljajte si podjetje, ki želi vstopiti na nov mednarodni trg. Za to je treba zbrati ključne informacije – analizirati trende rasti, prepoznati glavne dejavnike in oceniti konkurenčno okolje. Naša ekipa oceni izvedljivost vstopa na trg in pripravi strategije za uspeh. To pomeni reševanje kompleksnih izzivov v tesnem timskem sodelovanju. Sodelovali boste tudi pri projektih rasti, pripravi strategij prevzemov ter podpori pri integracijah podjetij. Ob tem boste pridobivali vpoglede v različne industrije, podprti z znanjem izkušenih sodelavcev in poglobljenim analitičnim delom.
Kaj je za nas pomembno
Zavedamo se, da ste na začetku kariere, vendar nekaj stvari je pri tej vlogi ključnih.
Glavne odgovornosti
Izvajanje poglobljenih tržnih analiz
: samostojno boste izvajali obsežne raziskave trgov ter uporabljali različna analitična orodja in metode za oblikovanje vpogledov.
Sodelovanje pri strateških projektih
: aktivno boste vključeni v iniciative, povezane z vstopom na trg, načrti rasti in širitvami.
Priprava analitičnih poročil
: pripravljali boste poglobljena poročila in predstavitve, ki vključujejo ugotovitve analiz, študije izvedljivosti in strateška priporočila.
Reševanje problemov
: k izzivom boste pristopali analitično in strukturirano, z jasnim fokusom na razumevanje problema in oblikovanje rešitve.
Strateški prispevek in izvedba
: sodelovali boste pri oblikovanju in izvedbi načrtov rasti ter pri aktivnostih, povezanih s prevzemi in združitvami.
Učenje in timsko delo
: pričakujemo proaktivnost pri učenju, spremljanju trendov, tehnologij in dinamike trgov ter aktivno sodelovanje v ekipi.
Pogoji za prijavo
Imate zaključeno
visokošolsko izobrazbo (ali boste diplomirali v tem študijskem letu).
Zanima vas svetovanje na področju
strategije; predhodne izkušnje
so prednost, niso pa pogoj.
Poleg
slovenščine
dobro govorite in pišete
angleško
, saj delujemo regionalno in poteka komunikacija v angleščini.
Imate zdravo mero logičnega razmišljanja in ostanete mirni tudi v zahtevnejših obdobjih. Pogosto se boste hitro spoznavali z novimi temami.
Najpomembneje –
ujemati se moramo kot ekipa
. Ker bomo veliko časa skupaj, je pomembno, da se dobro ujamemo tudi osebnostno.
Zaželene lastnosti
Globalen pogled
: razumevanje različnih kultur in zmožnost orientacije na mednarodnih trgih, s pripravljenostjo raziskovati tudi izven lokalnega okolja.
Sposobnost delovanja v nejasnih situacijah
: dobro se znajdete v okoljih, kjer ni vseh informacij, in ostanete zbrani, prilagodljivi in usmerjeni v rezultat.
Potencial za vodenje
: vidni znaki pobude, vpliva in odgovornosti, ki kažejo potencial za kasnejše vodstvene vloge.
Odnose s strankami
: sposobnost gradnje zaupanja, jasnega komuniciranja in razumevanja potreb naročnikov.
Ponujamo konkurenčno začetno plačo in letni bonus glede na uspešnost dela. Poleg tega pa še ugodnosti, ki vas bodo razveselile:
Prosti čas
: od 26 dni letnega dopusta.
Priporočilni bonus
: do 600 EUR za uspešno priporočilo novega sodelavca.
Šport
: timski športni proračun za fitnes, padel, badminton in podobne aktivnosti.
Zavarovanja
: obsežno nezgodno in življenjsko zavarovanje.
Razvoj
: dostop do izjemnega programa strokovnega razvoja, široke palete tečajev, Udemy.com, jezikovnih tečajev, internega coachinga ter podpore izkušenih kolegov.
Timsko vzdušje in druženje
: pri nas ni vse le delo – pogosto organiziramo druženja, večerje, bowling, interne zabave in dogodke, ki krepijo povezanost ekipe.
Bonusi:
glede na uspešnost posameznika in celotnega EY Slovenija.

FS Consulting, Product, Sales & Distribution Transformation Consultant (Senior Associate - Manager)
Singapore
Job Description
Role Overview:
We are looking for a Transformation Consultant to join our Financial Services Consulting practice in Singapore. The role focuses on transforming banks’ front to middle office operations – from customer strategy and sales/service processes to target operating model (TOM) design – to drive efficiency, innovation, and improved client outcomes. You will work with leading banks (across retail, commercial, private banking, etc.) to analyze their current organization and processes, then design future-state solutions encompassing operating model changes, process re-engineering, and digital enablement. As a Senior Associate, you will deliver core analyses and support project delivery; as a Manager, you will lead engagements, manage stakeholders, and ensure projects meet their strategic objectives.
Key Responsibilities:
Front-Office Consulting Projects: Collaborate with client teams to identify pain points and improvement opportunities in front-office functions (e.g. customer lifecycle management, sales processes, product management, relationship management, digital channels). Develop recommendations to bridge gaps between the current state and desired future state – whether by redesigning business processes, implementing new digital tools, or developing new operating models for front-line teams
Target Operating Model Design: Lead efforts to design and implement target operating models (TOM) for front-office transformation. Define clear roles, processes, governance, and technology requirements to support new front-office strategies at scale (e.g. redesign of sales and service structures, integration of digital channels, product lifecycle management). Ensure that the new TOM aligns with clients’ strategic objectives and incorporates best practices in customer experience and operational efficiency
Project Leadership & Delivery: For Manager-level hires, oversee end-to-end project management – including planning engagement scope, managing project teams (often multi-disciplinary), tracking project milestones, and ensuring quality delivery of outcomes
Change Management & Implementation: Support clients in executing transformation initiatives, including change management, stakeholder alignment, and implementation planning. Develop actionable roadmaps and implementation plans (e.g. phased roll-out of new processes, staff training plans, customer communication strategies) to ensure sustainable adoption of new front-office models
Client Engagement & Thought Leadership: Work closely with KPMG partners and directors on client management and business development activities. Build credible relationships with client stakeholders (from front-line managers to C-suite) by demonstrating understanding of their business, and by delivering tangible value. Contribute to internal knowledge development – for example, by creating thought leadership on trends (agentic sales transformation, service evolution, lending transformation etc.) and helping to refine KPMG’s front line sales, service and product transformation offerings
⠀
Required Experience & Skills:
Relevant Experience: 5 - 8+ years of professional experience in banking or consulting, with a focus on operations, business transformation, or process improvement. Experience with target operating model projects, sales & service effectiveness, or front-line technology implementation (e.g. CRM systems, digital banking platforms) is highly valued
Consulting & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities – able to assess complex operational issues, carry out data-driven analysis (process mapping, efficiency analysis, etc.), and derive actionable solutions. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills are essential, as is the ability to craft clear recommendations and business cases for change. Prior consulting experience or project management exposure is a plus
Industry & Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of banking functions and trends – such as sales and relationship management, customer service processes, digital channels and customer experience innovations, and operational best practices in wholesale, commercial or private banking. Familiarity with methodologies like Lean Six Sigma or process re-engineering is advantageous for addressing efficiency improvements and process redesign
Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills both written and verbal, to effectively engage with client stakeholders and produce high-quality reports and presentations. Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work seamlessly in a team environment and manage stakeholders at multiple levels. For Manager roles, robust stakeholder and change management skills are required to facilitate buy-in and navigate organizational complexities during transformation
Preferred Qualifications:
Education: A minimum of a bachelor’s degree. An MBA or other advanced degree is considered a strong asset, especially with specialization in operations management, strategy, or financial services
Certifications: Credentials in Project Management (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2) or Process Improvement (e.g. Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt) are beneficial
Leadership & Management: For Manager-level candidates, demonstrated experience in leading project teams or significant workstreams in a consulting or corporate environment

Technology Enablement, Procurement, Senior Associate - Assistant Manager
Singapore
Job Description
KPMG has a strong Digital Transformation team in this region, and we are assisting several clients with End-to-End business transformation initiatives incorporating Supply Chain & Procurement products such as COUPA, Jaggaer, o9, Ivalua and Zycus. Our practice is further expanding, and we are currently seeking an experienced Procurement Consultant with strong Procure-to-Pay (P2P) expertise and a proven track record in delivering end-to-end Ivalua implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be hands-on, able to manage client engagements independently, and bring deep knowledge of procurement processes, functional design, testing, and change management.
This position is based in Singapore.
Responsibilities:
Deliver comprehensive end-to-end Ivalua implementation projects for the P2P workstream
Apply strong functional knowledge of procurement, sourcing, contracting, supplier management, and invoicing processes to align with client requirements
Manage project workstreams independently, taking on roles such as Functional Design Lead, Testing Lead, Project Manager, and Change Management Support
Lead functional design workshops, including requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis
Create project documentation, including to-be process flows, business process documents, configuration workbooks, testing strategies, test scenarios, test scripts, and training materials
Lead and execute testing phases, including SIT, UAT, and Regression testing
Support change management activities and deliver end-user and supplier training
Collaborate closely with client stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, and suppliers to ensure successful adoption and business outcomes
Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and procurement best practices to deliver innovative solutions
Support integration activities with client ERPs such as SAP, Oracle, or Workday (preferred)
The ideal candidate should possess:
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university (preferred)
Minimum 5+ years in supply chain consulting or relevant industry roles, with a proven track record of delivering successful projects and driving measurable business impact
Proven experience in end-to-end Ivalua implementation across multiple projects
Strong expertise in P2P functional processes
Hands-on experience in leading workshops, preparing documentation, and managing testing phases
Ability to independently manage client engagements and take on multiple roles
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
ERP integration experience (SAP, Oracle, Workday, etc.) is an advantage
